project.name: CVMaker
project.tagline: Turn a simple form into a beautiful, shareable CV website.
project.description: CVMaker lets anyone build a professional resume website by filling in a guided form (contact, summary, experience, education, skills, projects, languages). The app renders their answers into a hand-picked template, gives a live preview, and produces both a shareable hosted page (/r/:slug) and a one-click vector PDF download. Users can also import an existing resume file (PDF/DOCX) to pre-fill the form. Built entirely on the free tier: Netlify hosting + Firebase (auth + Firestore) backend + @react-pdf/renderer for true vector PDF export.
project.status: Phase 0 - scaffold (React stack confirmed, Firebase + react-pdf integrated)
project.license: MIT (project code); templates carry their own licenses

web.rendering: Templates are React components keyed by template id; resume data is a plain typed schema
web.pdf_export: @react-pdf/renderer — true vector PDF (selectable/searchable text) rendered client-side, one-click download with no print dialog (see web/src/lib/pdf.ts)
web.file_import: mammoth.js for .docx → HTML; pdf.js (or unpdf) for .pdf → text; best-effort mapping into the schema

tech_stack.backend: Firebase (free Spark plan): anonymous auth + Firestore collection `resumes` keyed by share slug { resume, slug, updatedAt } — config via web/.env (see web/.env.example); app falls back to localStorage when unconfigured
tech_stack.hosting: Netlify (free) — web/ subfolder, auto-deploy from GitHub main

flow.1_choose_template: Pick a template (Modern / Minimal / Classic / Creative / Tech) — switching templates never loses data
flow.2_fill_form: Guided sections: Contact, Summary/About, Experience, Education, Skills, Projects, Languages, Links. Optional: upload existing PDF/DOCX to pre-fill
flow.3_live_preview: Real-time preview pane renders the selected template as data changes
flow.4_share_and_export: Shareable hosted URL (/r/:slug) + Download PDF via print dialog + export/import JSON backup
flow.5_edit_anytime: Return to edit; every change re-renders live

templates.registry: web/src/templates/index.ts — maps template id → React component + metadata (name, vibe, accent color, tags)
templates.customization: per-template accent color picker; section order preserved from the form
templates.user_templates: Users can send their own HTML/CSS templates — each gets converted to a React component + registered in the registry

sections: contact: fullName, headline, email, phone, location, website, linkedin, github, photoUrl
experience: [{ id, role, company, location, startDate, endDate, current, bullets[] }]
education: [{ id, degree, school, location, startDate, endDate, details }]
skills: [{ id, name, level (1-5) }] or free-tag list
projects: [{ id, name, description, link, tech[] }]

share_page.slug: derived from fullName + short random suffix
share_page.backend: Firestore doc resumes/:slug when Firebase configured; localStorage fallback otherwise
share_page.pwa: manifest + service worker so shared resumes are viewable offline (future)
share_page.meta: per-resume og:title/og:image for clean link previews

monetization_ideas.free: unlimited resumes on seed templates, PDF download, share links
monetization_ideas.paid_later: premium templates, custom accents, no CVMaker badge, direct one-click PDF (already free via @react-pdf/renderer), resume scoring/AI tips

roadmap.phase_0: Scaffold: repo, master file, docs, web app, template engine, 5 seed templates
roadmap.phase_1: Form UX + live preview + share links (Firestore) + one-click vector PDF export (@react-pdf/renderer)
roadmap.phase_2: Import existing resume (PDF/DOCX) with best-effort mapping
roadmap.phase_3: Firebase auth (anonymous + email), saved resume list, user template uploads
roadmap.phase_4: Monetization (premium templates / badge removal), PWA offline, analytics

directory_note: This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for CVMaker. Update it with every meaningful change (user asks for it periodically).
